description: Cluster-level comparison of a Zilla infrastructure model, excluding the monitoring namespace.

panels.description: Sum of container CPU usage across the selected application namespaces. Monitoring is excluded so the stack is not counted as model cost.

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m]))

panels.title: CPU cores

panels.description: Sum of container memory working set. This is additive across pods and excludes the monitoring namespace.

targets.expr: sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"})

panels.title: Memory working set

panels.description: Count of pods currently in the Running phase. Monitoring pods are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", phase="Running"} == 1)

panels.title: Running pods

panels.description: Total container restarts in the last hour. Use this to compare stability across models, not as a per-pod gauge average.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod"}[1h]))

panels.title: Restarts (1h)

panels.description: Share of CFS periods that were throttled. This is a ratio of rates, not a sum of gauge percentages.

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: CPU throttle ratio

panels.description: cAdvisor OOM events in the last hour. Complements kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason for killed containers.

targets.expr: sum(increase(container_oom_events_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[1h]))

panels.title: OOM events (1h)

panels.description: Application CPU by namespace. In ISO this maps to a tenant; in shared/hybrid it is the shared stack. Monitoring is excluded.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m]))

panels.title: CPU by namespace

panels.description: Working-set memory by namespace. Gauges are summed across pods in a namespace because memory is additive.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"})

panels.title: Memory by namespace

panels.description: Per-pod CPU. Each series is one pod; do not treat this as a tenant split on shared backends.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m]))

panels.title: CPU by pod

panels.description: Per-pod working set. Shown per pod rather than averaged, so a single large process is visible.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"})

panels.title: Memory by pod

panels.description: Hourly restart increase per pod. Useful when comparing isolated tenants against a shared process.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod"}[1h]))

panels.title: Restarts by pod

panels.description: Per-pod throttle ratio from CFS periods. Ratio of rates, never a summed percentage.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: CPU throttling by pod

panels.description: Pods whose last termination reason is OOMKilled. This is a 0/1 gauge per container, shown as a sum of currently marked containers.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", reason="OOMKilled"})

panels.title: OOM-killed containers

panels.description: Pod count by Kubernetes phase. Each phase is counted, not averaged, across the selected namespaces.

targets.expr: sum by (phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod"} == 1)

panels.title: Pods by phase

panels.description: Application request rate from zilla_http_requests_total. Multiple backend pods are summed after rate().

targets.expr: sum(rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Requests per second

panels.description: 5xx share of HTTP requests. Built from two counters so a missing error series becomes 0 rather than inflating the ratio.

targets.expr: sum(rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod", status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Error rate

panels.description: Request latency from histogram buckets. histogram_quantile is applied after summing buckets across pods by le.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(zilla_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])))

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: HTTP rate split by the backend tenant label. This is the correct tenant view for shared backends, which are a single scrape target.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(zilla_http_requests_total{zilla_target_type="backend", model=~"$model", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", tenant=~"$tenant", group=~"$group", service=~"$service", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]))

panels.title: Requests per second by tenant

panels.description: CPU of pods that carry zilla.io/tenant. Shared data-layer pods without that label are omitted here and remain in the namespace panels.

targets.expr: sum by (label_zilla_io_tenant) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m]) * on(namespace, pod) group_left(label_zilla_io_tenant) kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!="monitoring", pod=~"$pod", label_zilla_io_tenant=~"$tenant", label_zilla_io_tenant!=""})

panels.title: CPU by tenant label
